# RouteKit documentation

> RouteKit is an open-source CLI and authenticated model gateway for coding tools, API providers, and subscription pools.

These documents describe the current product behavior on `main`, including changes scheduled for the next package release. Version numbers in changelogs and evidence reports are historical records, not alternate operating instructions.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Agent guide](/docs/getting-started/agent-guide.md): Compact operating rules, safe command selection, verification, and recovery.
- [Command manifest](/agent/commands.json): Current CLI syntax plus automation and safety metadata.
- [Error manifest](/agent/errors.json): Structured CLI and control error meanings and remediation.
- [Full documentation corpus](/llms-full.txt): All processed documentation in one text response.

## Source and precedence

- [Source repository](https://github.com/velum-labs/routekit): Product and documentation source of truth.
- [Supported coding tool versions](/docs/reference/client-compatibility.md): Authoritative supported coding-tool builds.
- [CLI command reference](/docs/reference/commands.md): Human-readable CLI reference; use the command manifest for structured lookup.

## Agent entry points

- [Use RouteKit from an agent](/docs/getting-started/agent-guide.md): A compact operating contract for agents configuring, using, and recovering RouteKit.
- [Welcome to RouteKit](/docs.md): Pool coding subscriptions and use discovered models across coding tools through one local gateway.
- [Quickstart](/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Let your agent set up RouteKit, or get one working model route yourself in about five minutes.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install the RouteKit CLI on macOS or Linux and verify that it is ready.
- [Choose a RouteKit workflow](/docs/guides/user-guide.md): Choose a focused RouteKit workflow for setup, integration, operation, or recovery.

## Configure routes

- [Router configuration reference](/docs/reference/configuration.md): Canonical router schema, provider policy, model policy, aliases, reasoning, and leaderboard retention.
- [AWS Bedrock setup](/docs/guides/aws-bedrock.md): Configure AWS identity, least privilege, model discovery, and live verification for Amazon Bedrock.
- [Models and catalog behavior](/docs/reference/model-catalog.md): How RouteKit discovers, filters, lists, and routes models.

## Connect coding tools and APIs

- [Connect coding tools](/docs/guides/coding-tools.md): Launch qualified Codex or Claude Code builds, or install persistent RouteKit client settings.
- [Call the HTTP gateway](/docs/guides/http-gateway.md): Authenticate and send OpenAI, Responses, or Anthropic-compatible requests through RouteKit.
- [Supported coding tool versions](/docs/reference/client-compatibility.md): Exact client builds qualified with RouteKit.

## Pool subscriptions

- [Pool subscription accounts](/docs/guides/subscription-pooling.md): Enroll Claude Code or Codex accounts and route across eligible members of one subscription kind.
- [Subscription pools and routing](/docs/concepts/subscription-routing.md): How RouteKit discovers models, selects accounts, recovers credentials, and contains failover within a subscription pool.

## Operate and recover

- [Monitor and operate RouteKit](/docs/guides/operations.md): Inspect RouteKit health, account activity, quota, calls, logs, and retained rollups.
- [Set up a remote gateway](/docs/guides/remote-gateway.md): Provision, enroll, select, and operate a shared RouteKit gateway over HTTPS and SSH.
- [Troubleshoot RouteKit](/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): Recover from daemon startup, model discovery, subscription, remote, and configuration failures.

## Understand and verify

- [Architecture and request flow](/docs/concepts/architecture.md): How the RouteKit CLI, singleton daemon, gateway, and provider routes work together.
- [Data, credentials, and privacy](/docs/concepts/privacy.md): What RouteKit stores locally and what leaves your machine.
- [CLI command reference](/docs/reference/commands.md): Complete public RouteKit CLI command reference.
- [Package map](/docs/reference/packages.md): RouteKit TypeScript package map and ownership.
- [TypeScript API status](/docs/reference/api.md): Unsupported embedded packages and local TypeDoc generation.

## Develop and review history

- [Develop RouteKit from source](/docs/guides/source-development.md): Install the repository toolchain and run RouteKit's build and verification workflows.
- [Changelog](/docs/changelog.md): Recent RouteKit CLI releases generated from canonical package history.

## Additional documentation

- [Routes and billing](/docs/reference/routes-and-billing.md): Credential ownership, billing boundaries, egress, fallback behavior, and qualification status for RouteKit routes.

## Safety boundary

Do not infer unlimited use. Provider terms, subscription eligibility, quotas, and billing apply. A namespaced model selects its configured route; subscription pools rotate only within the same subscription kind and never fall back to paid API-key providers.
